literature_notes: All four ledger lines were evaluated. L1, L2, and L3 report TagRFP-T (and EGFP) fused at the start codon of CLDN1 (residue 1), confirmed by the GGSGGSGGS linker description. Per the authoritative topology landmarks, residues 1–7 are intracellular; a tag prepended before residue 1 therefore faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular space. This is a tolerated intracellular N-terminal insertion recorded in other_positions. L4 reports 'HA-tagged CLDN1' overexpressed in SW480 cells but names no residue, no loop, and no junction. CLDN1 has no extracellular terminus (N-terminus 1–7 and C-terminus 183–211 are both intracellular), so the topology-derived rule for a sole extracellular terminus cannot be applied. The tag position is genuinely unstated and cannot be pinned to any extracellular site. No ledger line supports a surface tag site for CLDN1.

literature_other_positions.note: TagRFP-T (and EGFP per L3) fused via GGSGGSGGS linker at the start codon of CLDN1; residues 1–7 are intracellular per topology landmarks, so this N-terminal tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
